# Weddings with Erica

Weddings with Erica is an Irish wedding planning and wedding day coordination service led by Erica Egan.

Website: https://weddingswitherica.com/

## Service area

Weddings with Erica supports couples across Ireland, including Cork, Kerry, Limerick, Clare, Galway, Dublin and other Irish wedding destinations.

## Services

- Signature Day Coordination: support before and during the wedding day for couples who have planned their wedding and want calm on-the-day delivery.
- Partial Planning Support: flexible planning guidance, supplier recommendations, timelines and coordination for couples who want expert support while leading their own planning.
- Full Planning + Coordination: end-to-end wedding planning support from venue and supplier planning through to full wedding day coordination.
- Planning Power Hour: a focused wedding planning consultation for couples who need clarity, guidance and next steps.
